loop_join: The final beat p14 (short323_14.png, an empty small-venue interior at night) carries isCta:true and rewind:true, so DepthImageV runs that beat's dolly backward ([1,0] instead of [0,1]): instead of pushing in further under the FULL CASE card it eases back out to the same base framing every beat opens at. That matches the opening energy of frame 0 (p01, short323_01.png, a sheet of grey convoluted egg-crate acoustic foam), so the restart reads as a continuation of camera motion rather than a hard cut, even though the two plates are different photographs.
second_watch_detail: The spray can beside a sheet of foam at p06 reads as a stray workshop still life on the first pass; once L2-L4 establish that only the non-fire-retarded grade ignited while the fire-retarded foam and bare wood did not, the same frame reads as showing how an ordinary consumer product could sit right next to the wrong material with nobody testing which was which.
